statements.quote: EMEA net sales increased 20.0% and were up 10.5% organically, driven by large colocation data center activity and telecom providers investing in capacity expansions.
statements.notes: Fourth-quarter EMEA sales growth is attributed partly to colocation data-center demand and partly to telecom demand. The 20.0% and 10.5% figures are growth rates of regional sales, not a data-center revenue amount or share, so the statement is recorded as qualitative. Q4 2021 falls in fiscal 2021.
